arxiv-2304-11050.title: Blow-up for the 1D cubic NLS
arxiv-2304-11050.creator: Valeria Banica, Renato Lucà, Nikolay Tzvetkov, Luis Vega
arxiv-2304-11050.description: Abstract . We consider the 1D cubic NLS on ℝ \mathbb{R} and prove a blow-up result for functions that are of borderline regularity, i.e. H s H^{s} for any s < − 1 2 s<-\frac{1}{2} for the Sobolev scale and ℱ ​ L ∞ \mathcal{F}L^{\infty} for the Fourier-Lebesgue scale.

arxiv-2305-12155.title: Neutron stars in scalar torsion theories with non minimal coupling
arxiv-2305-12155.creator: and Hamza Boumaza
arxiv-2305-12155.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by and Hamza Boumaza. We explore the existence and configurations of static and slowly rotating neutron stars (NSs) within a specific truncation of teleparallel scalar torsion theory. In this model, a scalar field ϕ \phi is non-minimally coupled to the torsion scalar as ξ ​ T ​ ϕ 2 \xi T\phi^{2} , in the presence of the scalar potential V ( ϕ ) = − μ 2 ϕ 2 / 2 + λ ϕ 4 / 4 V({\phi})=-\mu^{2}{\phi}^{2}/2+\lambda{\phi}^{4}/4 .

arxiv-2306-10626.title: Exclusive η c \eta_{c} production from small- x x evolved Odderon at a electron-ion collider
arxiv-2306-10626.creator: Sanjin Benić, Davor Horvatić, Abhiram Kaushik, Eric Andreas Vivoda
arxiv-2306-10626.description: Abstract We compute exclusive η c \eta_{c} production in high energy electron-nucleon and electron-nucleus collisions that is sensitive to the Odderon. In perturbative QCD the Odderon is a C C -odd color singlet consisting of at least three t t -channel gluons exchanged with the target.

arxiv-2511-16639.title: Codec2Vec: Self-Supervised Speech Representation Learning Using Neural Speech Codecs
arxiv-2511-16639.creator: 1 st Wei-Cheng Tseng, 2 nd David Harwath
arxiv-2511-16639.description: Abstract Recent advancements in neural audio codecs have not only enabled superior audio compression but also enhanced speech synthesis techniques. Researchers are now exploring their potential as universal acoustic feature extractors for a broader range of speech processing tasks. Building on this trend, we introduce Codec2Vec, the first speech representation learning framework that relies exclusively on discrete audio codec units.

arxiv-2511-20960.title: Geometric Calibration and Neutral Zones for Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Class Classification
arxiv-2511-20960.creator: Soumojit Das, Nairanjana Dasgupta, Prashanta Dutta, [0.5em] Washington State University, Pullman, WA, [0.3em] Corresponding author: soumojit.das@wsu.edu
arxiv-2511-20960.description: Abstract Modern artificial intelligence systems make critical decisions yet often fail silently when uncertain—even well-calibrated models provide no mechanism to identify which specific predictions are unreliable. We develop a geometric framework addressing both calibration and instance-level uncertainty quantification for neural network probability outputs.

arxiv-2512-21029.title: Critical Points of Degenerate Metrics on Algebraic Varieties: A Tale of Overparametrization
arxiv-2512-21029.creator: Giovanni Luca Marchetti *, Erin Connelly *, Paul Breiding *, Kathlén Kohn *
arxiv-2512-21029.description: Abstract We study the critical points over an algebraic variety of an optimization problem defined by a quadratic objective that is degenerate. This scenario arises in machine learning when the dataset size is small with respect to the model, and is typically referred to as overparametrization.

pmc-11312078.title: Untapped Potential of Side Stream Products from the Industrial Processing of Fruits: The Biosorption of Anthocyanins on Raspberry Seeds
pmc-11312078.creator: Dragana Dabić Zagorac, Milica Sredojević, Milica Fotirić Akšić, Ivanka Ćirić, Biljana Rabrenović, Ilinka M Pećinar, Maja Natić, Ana Isabel Andrés, María Luisa Timón Andrada, María Jesús Petrón Testón

The aim of the present work was to investigate the raspberry seeds and their sorption potential in the recovery of natural pigments.

pmc-11417155.title: PeptiHub: a curated repository of precisely annotated cancer-related peptides with advanced utilities for peptide exploration and discovery
pmc-11417155.creator: Sara Zareei, Babak Khorsand, Alireza Dantism, Neda Zareei, Fereshteh Asgharzadeh, Shadi Shams Zahraee, Samane Mashreghi Kashan, Shirin Hekmatirad, Shila Amini, Fatemeh Ghasemi, Maryam Moradnia, Atena Vaghf, Anahid Hemmatpour, Hamdam Hourfar, Soudabeh Niknia, Ali Johari, Fatemeh Salimi, Neda Fariborz
pmc-11417155.description: Peptihub (https://bioinformaticscollege.ir/peptihub/) is a meticulously curated repository of cancer-related peptides (CRPs) that have been documented in scientific literature. A diverse collection of CRPs is included in the PeptiHub, showcasing a spectrum of effects and activities. While some peptides demonstrated significant anticancer efficacy, others exhibited no discernible impact, and some even possessed alternative non-drug functionalities, including drug carrier or carcinogenic attributes.

pmc-11430989.title: Multiple Localization Analysis of the Major QTL—sfw 2.2 for Controlling Single Fruit Weight Traits in Melon Based on SLAF Sequencing
pmc-11430989.creator: Yi Cai, Di Wang, Ye Che, Ling Wang, Fan Zhang, Tai Liu, Yunyan Sheng, Shaolan Yang
pmc-11430989.description: Cucumis melo is an annual dicotyledonous trailing herb. It is fruity, cool, and refreshing to eat and is widely loved by consumers worldwide. The single fruit weight is an important factor affecting the yield, and thus the income and economic benefits, of melon crops.

pmc-11523775.title: Towards realist-informed ripple effects mapping (RREM): positioning the approach
pmc-11523775.creator: Kevin Harris, James Nobles, Louis Ryan, Christoph Szedlak, Hannah Taylor, Rowena Hawkins, Alice Cline, Elizabeth Smith, Amelia Hall
pmc-11523775.description: BackgroundEvaluation approaches such as ripple effects mapping (REM) and realist evaluation have emerged as popular methodologies to evidence impact, and the processes of change within public health as part of whole systems approaches. Despite the various examples of their implementation across different evaluation settings, there has been little or no evidence of how they might be effective when combined.

pmc-12368119.title: Automatic detection of cognitive events using machine learning and understanding models’ interpretations of human cognition
pmc-12368119.creator: Quang Dang, Murat Kucukosmanoglu, Michael Anoruo, Golshan Kargosha, Sarah Conklin, Justin Brooks
pmc-12368119.description: The pupillary response is a valuable indicator of cognitive workload, capturing fluctuations in attention and arousal governed by the autonomic nervous system. Cognitive events, defined as the initiation of mental processes, are closely linked to cognitive workload as they trigger cognitive responses.

pmc-12651291.title: A Deep Learning-Based Ensemble System for Brent and WTI Crude Oil Price Analysis and Prediction
pmc-12651291.creator: Yiwen Zhang, Salim Lahmiri, Xiaoguang Gao
pmc-12651291.description: Crude oil price forecasting is an important task in energy management and storage. In this regard, deep learning has been applied in the literature to generate accurate forecasts. The main purpose of this study is to design an ensemble prediction system based on various deep learning systems.

pmc-12693110.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Friction Stir Welded the Novel Al-Mg-Zn-Si Alloy
pmc-12693110.creator: Junzhe Huang, Ying Li, Xiwu Li, Hongwei Yan, Lizhen Yan, Kai Wen, Yanan Li, Guanjun Gao, Kai Zhu, Mingyang Yu, Yongan Zhang, Baiqing Xiong
pmc-12693110.description: The high-Mg-content Al-Mg-Zn-Si alloy, as a novel aluminum alloy, exhibits excellent strength, toughness, and corrosion resistance, demonstrating significant application potential in lightweight structural components for aerospace, weapon systems, rail transportation, and other fields. In this study, friction stir welding was employed to weld the high-Mg-content Al-Mg-Zn-Si alloy.

pmc-12766113.title: A Case Report of a Rare Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus with Chin Prostration
pmc-12766113.creator: Wanni Li, Wen Luo, Yujia Liang, Ping Wang, Chunxia Wang, Jiejie Lu, Weiwei Wu
pmc-12766113.description: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus (SCLE) is a clinical subtype of cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE), an autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by photosensitive rashes. This report presents a rare case of SCLE involving the chin. The patient presented with an annular, erythematous, scaling plaque on the left chin, which had been repeatedly misdiagnosed.

pmc-13197239.title: Prevalence and risk factors for acute kidney injury at the diagnosis of juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children and its long-term implications for kidney health
pmc-13197239.creator: Maria Francesca Gicchino, Mattia Arenella, Caterina De Simone, Federica Di Domenico, Maria Grazia Fusco, Silvio Naviglio, Paola Tirelli, Giulio Rivetti, Anna Di Sessa, Stefano Guarino, Emanuele Miraglia del Giudice, Alma Nunzia Olivieri, Francesca Orlando, Pierluigi Marzuillo
pmc-13197239.description: BackgroundWe aimed to investigate the prevalence and risk factors of acute kidney injury (AKI) at juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) onset and its impact on long-term kidney outcomes.MethodsIn this multicenter study, we retrospectively reviewed 192 children diagnosed with JIA (1998–2025). AKI was defined according to KDIGO serum creatinine criteria.

pmc-13387377.title: Personalized Biologic Therapy for Refractory Bullous Pemphigoid: Sequential Omalizumab, Dupilumab, and Rituximab
pmc-13387377.creator: Lang Yu, Gang Hu, Quanhong Zhang, Yue Zhu, Liuqing Chen, Jinbo Chen
pmc-13387377.description: Bullous pemphigoid (BP) is an autoimmune subepidermal blistering disease that predominantly affects elderly individuals. Systemic corticosteroids remain a mainstay of therapy but are often limited by comorbidities and treatment-related adverse effects. We report a 73-year-old man with refractory BP and multiple comorbidities who underwent sequential biologic therapy with omalizumab, dupilumab, and rituximab.

pmc-13624430.creator: Muhammad Abas Khan
pmc-13624430.description: Objectives:To determine the total leukocyte count (TLC) in patients with acute stroke and assess its association with stroke type and age.Methodology:This prospective observational study was conducted at the Department of Emergency Medicine, Lady Reading Hospital, Peshawar, from May to November 2025.
